documents.text: John Sparke (died 1566) John Sparke (died 1566) was an English politician who sat in the House of Commons in 1554. Sparke was originally from Nantwich, Cheshire and settled at Plympton St. Maurice. He was collector of the subsidy for Plympton Erle in 1523. In 1554, he was elected Member of Parliament for Plympton Erle. He was mayor of Plympton Erle later in the same year. Sparke died in 1566 and was buried in the church of Plympton St Maurice on 11 July 1566. Sparke married Jane Moore of Devon and had four sons. She was buried on 29 December
